clips.title: The story
paras: Telf Joolam sends a shaman across Durotar and the eastern Barrens for a Fire Sapta's ingredients. The draught prepares an initiate to perceive and speak with fire spirits.

A Fire Sapta opens a shaman’s senses to the Eternal Flame. Like the draught for earth, it lets a shaman see and speak with spirits hidden from mortal sight. Telf Joolam sends initiates across Durotar and into the eastern Barrens to gather ingredients bound to heat and flame.

Razormane quilboar spellcasters in the eastern Barrens carry fire tar, made in their earthy rituals. Burning Blade cultists carry the other needed ingredient in Dustwind Cave, in the ravines northeast of Razor Hill. The cultists use fire for destruction and demonic chaos, while the reagents in their pouches hold a natural tie to the element.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: But you did not come here for a history lesson, did you? You came for the Eternal Flame and fire totem.
The first step is to create a sapta and bind you to the flame.
I can create the fire sapta for you if you bring me two items. The first is fire tar, a simple item usually carried by Razormane spellcasters in eastern Barrens.
The second item will be more dangerous: a reagent pouch from one of the cultists of the Burning Blade. You can find them in a cave above the ravines northeast of Razor Hill.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I have enough ingredients for a sapta of fire if you can find the reagent pouch and some fire tar. The Burning Blade fanatics carry the proper components for most of their spells in those pouches, and usually have enough of the items I need that we will not have to search much farther for anything else.
The saptas are always made from ingredients that are closely tied to their respective elements. It makes our work easier because of the warlocks' ties to fire.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Fire is more than chaos and destruction--do well to remember that. It is also about life, and creation. All things are tied together in such a way. Forces oppose one another, but at the same time, one cannot exist without the other. Both extinguish one another, but also give one another meaning. Always remember this.
Using different types of magic in conjunction with one another will show not only true skill, but great wisdom.
